defs.def: the speed at which sb/sth walks, runs or moves （移动的）速度；步速
the speed at which sth happens 发生的速度；步伐；节奏

ex.s: Parenting sets the pace of a child’s growth.
ex.t: 养育子女决定了儿童成长的速度。

ex.s: If we see the elderly trying to catch their planes but walking at a snail’s pace, we find a wheelchair for them immediately.
ex.t: 如果我们看到老人试图赶飞机却以蜗牛般的速度行走，我们会立刻为他们找来轮椅。

ex.s: C take pride inD. keep pace with
ex.t: C. 以……为荣 D. 与……并驾齐驱

ex.s: It should keep pace with the procedure.
ex.t: 它应该跟上程序的节奏。

ex.s: Zhang Daqian (picture 4) Adopt the pace of nature: her secret is patience.
ex.t: 张大千（图4 ）走大自然的步伐：她的秘诀就是耐心。

ex.s: Life is queer with its twists and turns, As every one of us sometimes learns, And many a failure turns about, When he might have won had he stuck it out; Don't give up though the pace seems slow - You may succeed with another blow.
ex.t: 生活充满了曲折，我们每个人有时都会体会到，多少次的失败本可转为成功，只要他们当初坚持下去；即使步伐似乎缓慢，也千万不要放弃——你或许下一次努力就会成功。

ex.s: Masters of Time In the quiet courtyards of Xi San Suo, behind the high walls of the Forbidden City, time ticks at its own pace.
ex.t: 时间的大师：在紫禁城高墙后面西三所的宁静庭院里，时间以它自己的节奏滴答作响。

defs.def: an act of stepping once when walking or running; the distance travelled when doing this （走或跑时）迈出的一步，一步的距离；步幅
the fact of sth happening, changing, etc. quickly 迅速出现（或变化等）；快节奏

ex.s: In today’s fast-paced world, the saying that “time waits for no man” has never seemed more apt.
ex.t: 在当今快节奏的世界里，＂时不我待＂这句谚语似乎从未如此贴切。

defs.def: to do sth at a particular speed or to a particular standard so that other people are then forced to copy it if they want to be successful 确定速度；确立标准；领先

ex.s: He seized Tom by the jaw, and pulled open his mouth to inspect his teeth; made him strip up his sleeve, to show his muscle; turned him round, made him jump and spring, to show his paces.
ex.t: 他抓住汤姆的下巴，扒开他的嘴检查牙齿；让他卷起袖子展示肌肉；让他转圈、跳跃，展示他的步态。

defs.def: to run faster than the other people taking part, at a speed that they then try to copy 跑步比赛
to walk up and down in a small area many times, especially because you are feeling nervous or angry 来回踱步；走来走去
to set the speed at which sth happens or develops 确定速度；调整节奏
to find the right speed or rhythm for your work or an activity so that you have enough energy to do what you have to do 调整自己的工作（或活动）节奏
